[CITY] IMMEDIATELY
ANNOUNCED THE CHANGE.

FOLLOWING A FIVE-YEAR PERIOD DURING WHICH

THIS WAS THE INITIAL TIGHTENING MOVE.

THERE SEEMS TO BE A CONSIDERABLE

MANY CONFLICTING VIEWS IN THE
MARKET.
